label: The recorded Railton fragment is satisfiable with a true moral sentence, cognitive moral error and…
meaning: The recorded Railton fragment is satisfiable with a true moral sentence, cognitive moral error and a right act without a universal instrumental-reason link. A nonconstant equal-benefit finite model witnesses this; it does not establish actual objective grounding. This legacy theorem does not require Ascribes witnesses; the separately verified NATURALIST-RAILTON-ASCRIPTION-CONSISTENT does.
